_comment: GDD §5's v1 progression list, the last unbuilt line: 'A handful of passive trinkets (flat stat bonuses — found gear, no equip complexity).' Weapon swaps shipped in v7 and XP levels in v6; this closes the list. NO EQUIP COMPLEXITY is the load-bearing phrase — there is no inventory, no slots and no equip action. A unit walks over one and keeps it, the same way it walks over a weapon, and it stacks. That is also why every effect here is a flat number: anything conditional would need a rules surface to explain it, and this tier of item is explicitly the one that does not get one. Kept deliberately small and unexciting — a trinket should tilt a fight, never decide one; the interesting decisions in this game are on the board, not in a stat screen. `effect` keys name unit fields (maxHp, move) or weapon fields the unit's CURRENT weapon is read through (damage, range, hitChance), so a trinket keeps working after a weapon swap rather than being silently attached to the gun it was found with.
